beats.say: This is the emptiest country on Earth.
beats.title: THE EMPTIEST COUNTRY ON EARTH

beats.say: Mongolia is bigger than France, Germany, Italy and the UK combined.
But only about three and a half million people live there. That's around two people per square kilometer.
And almost half of them live in one city: Ulaanbaatar.
It's also the coldest capital city in the world. The average temperature over the whole year is below zero.
Squeezed between Russia and China, with no coast at all.
Huge country, almost nobody home. Follow for more.
beats.title: HUGE COUNTRY. NOBODY HOME.
